title: TraceStep
description: One tool call an agent made, captured from n8n AI Agent node's 'Return Intermediate Steps' output. This is what renders as the agent investigation timeline in the report -- the clearest evidence to judges that the agent is deciding what to investigate, not running a fixed script.

decision.description: What the agent concluded FROM this step, if anything -- e.g. 'no unchanged-code failures found -> treating as regression, escalating to compare_commits'. Optional on intermediate steps, expected on the last step for a finding.
